title: Discover this Hidden Gem in the Quiet Country Part of Killeen #texashomes
description:
Discover this Hidden Gem in the Quiet Country Part of Killeen #texashomes 

Rarely does an opportunity like this present itself—a ready-made compound tucked away at the end of a quiet dead-end road. From the moment you arrive, you'll be greeted by a sense of privacy and security, thanks to the expansive metal fence adorned with two automatic gates and a towering 6ft barrier that keeps unwanted guests at bay.

Nestled on 2.69+/- wooded acres, this property is a nature lover's paradise, attracting wildlife year-round. Step into your own oasis with a stunning year-round swimming pool and hot tub, complete with a one-of-a-kind cover for added convenience and allure. Adjacent to the pool, you'll find the oversized shop—a vast space. Whether you're into cars, woodworking, or crafts, you'll never run out of room to pursue your passions.

The full-length porch invites you to indulge in outdoor fun and dining, all while keeping an eye on the poolside action. The pool house, complete with a full kitchen and bath, offers the perfect retreat for guests or extended stays.

Inside, the home has four bedrooms, four and a half baths, and two spacious living areas, including a large-capacity media room ideal for movie nights or game days. The Master suite, thoughtfully positioned away from the other bedrooms, offers ultimate privacy and relaxation. With two full bathrooms—one featuring an extra-large walk-in shower—getting ready in the morning has never been easier.

This estate offers a perfect balance of formal and informal spaces, providing endless opportunities for entertaining and making memories with loved ones. Don't miss your chance to experience the magic of this extraordinary property firsthand—schedule your showing today!
